bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 3 月低点

read.en: AAOI fell 2.9% on Oct 15 to $83.73 on heavy volume after trading as low as $76.21. It is below every average: the 5-day ($95.6), 10-day ($107.4), falling 30-day ($104.1), rising 200-day ($112.0) and falling 100-day ($126.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero with a widening histogram; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($126.5), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: AAOI 10月15日放量下跌 2.9%，收于 $83.73，盘中最低至 $76.21。股价位于所有均线下方：5 日（$95.6）、10 日（$107.4）、下行的 30 日（$104.1）、上行的 200 日（$112.0）以及下行的 100 日均线（$126.1）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴之下且柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$126.5），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close broke the $84.6 March low, now first resistance (day's high $85.02); above it are the September floor ($93.6–97) with the 5-day average, then $104 (30-day average). The intraday drop stopped just above the $76 Jul 29 low. Support is $78.6 (Mar 31 low), then $76. A close below $76 would break the July low; a close above $85 would reopen $94.
read.zh: 收盘跌破 $84.6 的 3月低点，该位置转为第一阻力，当日高点为 $85.02；其上为 9月底部（$93.6–97）及 5 日均线，其次 $104（30 日均线）。盘中跌势止于 7月29日低点 $76 上方。支撑为 $78.6（3月31日低点），其次 $76。若收盘跌破 $76，将跌破 7月低点；若收盘回到 $85 上方，将重新打开至 $94 的空间。

r.en: March low, now resistance; Oct 15 high $85.02
